name: count
meaning: number of clips; App_InitGameSystems writes 3 into g_fmvListIntro (0x401a4f) and 1 into g_fmvListCredits (0x401a8f)

name: clips
meaning: clip file names, 0x100 apart (0x71bb24/0x71bc24/0x71bd24 at 0x401a5e..0x401a82; Video_PlaySequence indexes with shl 8 at 0x561708). 8 slots is inferred from the gap 0x71b318 -> 0x71bb20
